text: Canopy Danaids are butterflies located in northern side of Amirdrassil in the Emerald Dream.

Candleslag Quarry is a kobold-infested mine in the northwestern corner of the Ringing Deeps. The area is bordered by the Earthenworks to the east and the Hallowfall Gate to the south. The Earthenworks Weave skyriding race starts on the western wall up in the rafters.

Camp Murroch is a quest hub in south-central Ringing Deeps. The camp is nestled between the Living Grotto to the west, Taelloch to the east, the Rumbling Wastes to the north, and the Ancient Falls to the south.

Campalot is located in the Verdant Gutters in the Ringing Deeps. It is the home of the Knights of the Brown Table, led by Arfur. A Damp Passage Downwards in the lower parts lead to the home of the Lady of the Lake. Adventurers help out the Knights around the castle, brushing moles, mucking stalls, polishing treasures, and defeating sparring squires.
Cammy Peepers is a goblin located in the Tailgate Park in the Undermine.

Can You Believe What People Throw Away? is awarded to players who defeat the Gallagio Garbage rare encounter that has a chance of spawning after filling the progress bar at any random S.C.R.A.P. dig in Undermine. After an (unannounced) hotfix on 3 March 2025, the spawn rate for the Gallagio Garbage was increased up to roughly 33% (from ~1%), so the rare is much more available. The rare does not have a daily lockout, so it can be repeatedly farmed on one character, and can drop the mount even if already learned.

Canister of Darkfuse Solution is an item that can be purchased for 100 Resonance Crystals from Sitch Lowdown in the Undermine, used to summon the Darkfuse Precipitant rare elite enemy in Undermine. It requires friendly standing with Darkfuse Solutions to purchase.

Campsites are the backgrounds available for the character selection screen, customizable for each Warband. Players can arrange their character list into groups of four and assign each camp any unlocked campsite. The UI can be accessed via the "Campsites" tab in the Collections or from the top navigation bar at the character select screen. From in-game, the campsites can be viewed via its tab in the Warband Collections interface.

Camouflaged herbs are variants of herbs found throughout Khaz Algar that can only be seen and gathered while under the effects of Phial of Truesight. They can be gathered by players with the Herbalism skill. Camouflaged herbs appear like a normal herb but are semi-transparent and emit a mist from their base.
Camouflaged Arathor's Spear is a Camouflaged herb node found in the Isle of Dorn, the Ringing Deeps, and Hallowfall on Khaz Algar while under the effects of Phial of Truesight.
Crystallized Orbinid is a Camouflaged herb node found in Khaz Algar while under the effects of Phial of Truesight.
Camouflaged Mycobloom is a Camouflaged herb node that can be found in Khaz Algar while under the effects of Phial of Truesight.
Cane of the Runic Wanderer can be purchased from Aridormi in Dalaran for 1,500 Timewarped Badge.

The Candleclaw are a group of kobolds found in Darkflame Cleft in the Ringing Deeps. Presumably, they serve the Candle King directly. During the war in Khaz Algar, they pushed Knicknack and her family away from her home. They fought adventurers accompanying the kobold Skitter in a covert mission seeking to steal the :Candle Crown from the Candle King's hoard. Later, after the Candle King was deposed and fled back to the Darkflame Cleft, they faced a party of adventurers whose goal was to defeat the king and the last of his henchmen.
The Candlelits are a group of kobolds that have overrun Mourning Rise and Kriegval's Rest on the Isle of Dorn.

Captured Ravens are dread ravens located at Scalecracker Keep in the Waking Shores. They are being held captive by the Qalashi djaradin. One is chained and being beaten by two Qalashi Ragetamers while three other ravens stand nearby. Every so often, another Ragetamer comes and takes one, bringing it over to a nearby Qalashi Flamemaster who then transforms it into a Blazing Dreadsquall.

Captured Proto-Whelp are proto-dragon whelps located at the Wild Preserve in the Waking Shores. They are being held captive by Primalists who are attempting to corrupt them. After being freed, they run away and despawn shortly after.
Care and Feeding of the Imperial Lynx can be found next to Torran Dellain in the stable in Dunelle's Kindness in Hallowfall.
Captured Vile Fin Puddlejumper is a murloc captured with a Murloc Leash by the Horde adventurer in Whispering Shore in Tirisfal Glades. It is brought to Sedrick Calston and becomes Speckle.

Captain Trueflame is an Arathi located in Dunelle's Kindness in Hallowfall. She is in charge of scouts who protect and light the passageways of Hallowfall for Arathi citizens. When Scout Wayshelm and other scouts went silent, she sent an adventurer to find them. After being assisted, Wayshelm returned and reported how the other scouts had fallen and requested to visit the Veneration Grounds, which she allowed.
Captured Earthen's Ironhorns drop from trash mobs in Nerub-ar Palace.

Caretaker Bagdur is a stasis-locked earthen found in Mourning Rise in the Isle of Dorn. Once a celebrated Stormrider, she was discharged from their ranks when she turned away from Oathsworn beliefs. A lover of fine cinderbrew and gems, she was as ardent a Stormrider as she was a Caretaker.
Caretaker Dorgad is a stasis-locked earthen found in Mourning Rise in the Isle of Dorn. He and his fused, Caretaker Nattar, were the ones who named Mourning Rise to commemorate and honor Kriegval.

Captain Whitney was a Forsaken. In life, he was a human captain and decorated war hero of the Alliance who fought against orcs. In reality, Whitney was an ill-tempered, egotistical alcoholic who abused his men for the slightest offense, withheld rations from them while he never went hungry, got drunk every night and forced his soldiers to sing his praise. One night, a drunk Whitney accidentally got tangled in the ropes of a catapult and launched himself into an orcish camp. The orcs believed they were being attacked and retaliated against the humans. The Cartels of Undermine is the fifth Major Faction of . It has four sub-factions, based on favor gained with Monte Gazlowe (Bilgewater Cartel), Baron Revilgaz (Blackwater Cartel), Marin Noggenfogger (Steamwheedle Cartel), and Grimla Fizzlecrank (Venture Company). A fifth sub-faction (Gallagio Loyalty Rewards Club) is associated with the Liberation of Undermine raid. There's also Darkfuse Solutions, which unlocks after the first Chrome King Gallywix kill.

Cartographers are scouts and explorers who survey, document, and map the world of Azeroth and beyond. Their work involves charting unexplored territories, recording geographical features, and producing accurate maps for travelers and other organizations. It is their calling to know locations and directions. Precision is what distinguishes masters of the craft from their peers. Cartographers can be consulted when assessing land for future construction projects. They either work alone or as part of survey teams in order to gather additional information and improve the accuracy of their maps. Castle Nathria sets are the appearance sets associated with patch 9.0.2 and Castle Nathria, the first raid of . They are visually themed after the raid and offer no set bonuses. There are a total of four Castle Nathria appearance sets, one for each armor type. Despite not being proper tier sets, they are sometimes colloquially called Tier 26. Completing one of these sets will grant the Castle Vain achievement.

The Cataract River runs from the Waterworks at south to the Living Grotto at along the central western wall of the Ringing Deeps. The headwaters are at Shimmermist Falls and the river drains through the Living Grotto into Azj-Kahet.
